question: Who was the French Governor of Pondicherry prior to Dupleix, who defended the settlement against Maratha threats and was granted the personal title of Nawab and a mansab of 4,500 by the Mughal Emperor?
explanation: Benoit Dumas (Governor from 1735 to 1741) gave asylum to the family of the Nawab of Carnatic, Dost Ali, during the Maratha invasion of 1740, and successfully prepared Pondicherry to resist Maratha attack. In appreciation, the Mughal Emperor granted him the title of Nawab and a mansab of 4,500 horsemen, which was later transferred to his successor, Dupleix.

question: Following the successes in the Second Carnatic War, which Nizam of Hyderabad appointed Dupleix as the governor of all Mughal territories south of the Krishna River?
explanation: In 1750, after the death of Nasir Jung, Muzaffar Jung was placed on the throne of Hyderabad with French assistance. In gratitude, Muzaffar Jung appointed Dupleix as the governor of all Mughal territories south of the River Krishna and ceded significant territories to the French.
